title: 60.3% of accepted ## Friction entries name no policy file; the body contract never resolves the rule id
claim: Of the 174 `## Friction` entries policy_lint.mjs:frictionEntries accepts in the bodies of the 569 merged pull requests first-parent in v7.1.0..92d38ecb, 105 (0.603; 84 distinct ids) name no `--budgets` path under D13.M6's rule and 0 are ambiguous, so only 69 (0.397) attribute friction to a policy file, because checkPrBody refuses only an entry's shape and never that its `<rule_id>` names a rule.
mechanism: The template asks for `<rule_id>: <event>: <evidence>`; frictionEntries accepts any FRICTION_ID ([A-Za-z.][A-Za-z0-9_.#/-]*) and checkPrBody (policy_lint.mjs:7317) refuses only an entry whose id is null. Ids such as `brief` (4), `handoff-wip`, `frugal-routing`, `PROMPT.md`, `fixer-step-push` (3 each), `r10-process-slim-1..5`, tool and group names pass the contract and key their own verbatim histogram rows, so friction a seat aimed at a contract section (fixer-step-push, fixer-brief, fixer-step-6: 6 entries) reaches no policy file under either keying, and checkSunset's honour-rule test reads only the file keys.

evidence.unit: share of accepted friction entries naming exactly one --budgets path (69/174; no file 105, ambiguous 0)
evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out; counts over the committed snapshot window.json, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs:frictionEntries (what an accepted entry is; checked equal to statsHistogram's friction cells), :frictionKey via --normalize-friction-keys, :sizes/:policyFiles (the --budgets paths)

perturbation.change: --perturb readme: the first accepted entry naming ratchet-budgets.md (#3185) re-spelled `README.md` in its body (D13.md's fixture perturbation); --perturb bare / unticked re-spell it ratchet-budgets / unbackticked
perturbation.observed_value: readme: one_file 69 -> 68, ambiguous 0 -> 1 (tests/README.md, tools/audit/README.md); bare and unticked: one_file 69 unchanged, only the spelling row moves

metric_definition: accepted friction entries whose id (backticks stripped, # dropped) names exactly one --budgets path p (p is k, k.md, k/SKILL.md or ends in /k, /k.md, /k/SKILL.md), over all accepted entries
phenomenon_property: An accepted `## Friction` entry names the policy file it is friction with (or is refused), so every entry the contract accepts is countable against one rule by the histogram and by the sunset check

null_control.note: a spelling change that still names the same file moves no count: the share measures naming, not formatting

reproduction_steps: read RESULT one_file_share, no_file and the no-file rows
proposed_fix_scope: checkPrBody refuses a ## Friction id that names no policy file by the histogram's own resolution (frictionKey resolves to a policyFiles() path), with the template's <rule_id> naming the file; existing verbatim keys stay readable in --stats
